text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- New Israeli crime against Arabs. Israeli soldier shoots civilians in West Bank town of Hebron. U.S. President Clinton condemns "cowardly" attack.
- Islamic Resistance Movement Hamas says "full resistance will continue until elimination of Israeli occupation".
- Secretary-general of Gulf Cooperation Council states warns Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu: "Any aggression against Arabs will turn the region into a volcano."
- Egyptian parties to hold conference in support of Syria and Lebanon.
- Oman records big deficit in its 1997 budget.
- Swiss president reiterates his country's rejection of Zionist "blackmail".
- Israel continues aggression against south Lebanon. Lebanese resistance carried out 369 operations against Israeli occupation forces in 1996.
- Former U.N. secretary-general Ghali: "Middle East peace will be achieved sooner or later."
- Turkey continues military operations in northern Iraq, killing 72 Kurds.
